title: ITERON · GOVERNED HARNESS ARCHITECTURE
purpose: Show how Iteron keeps harness optimization offline and non-authoritative while a fixed runtime kernel alone admits effects and appends evidence.
caption: CANDIDATES PROPOSE. EVIDENCE, HUMANS, AND THE KERNEL DECIDE.

style.medium: formal systems-paper architecture diagram, precise flat boxes, thin marker-like connector lines, generous whitespace, compact monospace labels, no decoration
style.palette: navy text; purple candidate production; green evaluation and governance; amber human decision; cobalt runtime; red rejection

nodes.label: HARNESS CANDIDATE FACTORY
nodes.kind: search, bandit, structured mutation, text evolution, implementation selection

nodes.label: INDEPENDENT EVALUATION
nodes.kind: held-out quality, cost, latency, reliability and invariant checks

nodes.label: IMMUTABLE CHECKPOINT REGISTRY
nodes.kind: versioned policy bundles with known-good rollback

nodes.label: PINNED BUNDLE RESOLVER
nodes.kind: read-only identity resolution at run admission

nodes.label: TYPED STRATEGY SLOTS
nodes.kind: router, planner, context, memory, scheduler, tools, verifier, model router, collaboration

nodes.label: FIXED AUTHORITY KERNEL
nodes.kind: protocol, reducer, capability admission, budgets, effect broker, record and replay

nodes.label: EXECUTION MODULES
nodes.kind: providers, filesystem, shell and git, sandbox, MCP and LSP, vertical adapters

forbidden_edges.reason: A producer cannot activate its candidate.
Evaluation cannot bypass accountable human promotion.
A learned strategy cannot bypass capability admission and the effect broker.
Runtime evidence is committed through the fixed authority kernel.

layout_notes: Place the offline zone as a wide top band and the runtime zone as a wide bottom band.
Arrange the main success path left to right with the reject branch below independent evaluation.
Arrange the online runtime left to right as bundle resolver, typed strategy slots, fixed authority kernel, execution modules.
Route RA-10 and RA-11 in clearly separated upper and lower lanes; never use a double-headed arrow.
Route RA-12 around the far left margin from the fixed authority kernel to append-only evidence without touching a zone border.
Show a small red prohibition annotation between candidate factory and runtime: NO SELF-ACTIVATION. It is not an arrow.
Do not mention model training, SFT, DPO, GRPO, or RL anywhere in the figure.
